subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: When executing any verb, the harness shall run it scoped to the workspace, bounded by a per-verb time limit, and with a stripped environment passing only the variables the manifest declares for that verb.
rationale: repo-supplied commands are untrusted input; ambient credentials must be unreachable by construction
fit_criterion: a fixture verb reading an ambient environment variable observes it absent; a hanging fixture verb is terminated at its bound with rung result error-timeout; a fixture verb writing outside the workspace fails the run with a scope finding
